settings: user profile `[app:Civ5XP]`, `world_scale` ~0.1, `auto_noshift = 1` (shadows, baked terrain), `head_look = scroll` (look past the edge to scroll the map; untested in the game yet); Aspyr config.ini `MaxSimultaneousThreads = 8` plus the thread-count binary patch (notes; a `vrdual` command for it is planned)
notes: Works in the headset: shadows agree in both eyes, no crash with the thread patch.
The depth effect is modest for a top-down map.
Steam runs the native Linux port (Aspyr, from the Mac code), not the Windows build; Proton must be forced for that.

Port vs Windows build: DX9 renderer (no DX11-only options), not updated with Windows (version mismatch in multiplayer with Windows players), no mods that replace the game core DLL (e.g. Vox Populi); players report both better and worse performance than under Proton.

Port bug, also without vrdual (Steam reports since 2018): crash after a few to ~25 minutes. Each thread entering its TBB job system gets an index from an unbounded counter, but the per-thread render data has only n = `MaxSimultaneousThreads` slots (clamped to 3..16); two threads more than n enter, and a render job on such a thread reads a null slot.
Fix: binary patch, `JobManager_GetNumberThreads()` returns 16 (the port's own maximum), with `MaxSimultaneousThreads = 8`; over 30 minutes without a crash (before: 2-25 min).
Shadows: the game draws its shadow map at the 3D view's size into another target; `auto_noshift = 1` leaves it unshifted, so both eyes' shadows agree.

A dedicated mod exists: [witcher3-vr](https://github.com/tig3rmast3r/witcher3-vr) (next-gen DX12 v4.0.4, Windows, OpenXR) and its fork [joschi127/witcher3-vr](https://github.com/joschi127/witcher3-vr) (also Remastered 5.01, and Linux under Proton + WiVRn via `wineopenxr`, see its `LINUX.md`); made for this game (head-tracked camera, first person, HUD on its own layer), it may give a better result. vrdual took [shader rules](tasks/shader-rules.md) from it.
The mirror's twin instance carries the app's name and engine, so RADV enables `VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2` for vkd3d on both GPUs.
